name: Digicontent Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2017, Digicontent Ltd is engaged in Entertainment & Digital Innovation Business[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company provides content sourcing services through different digital and electronic media. On news websites, company manages advertising time and space. It also operates  other businesses in the entertainment and digital innovation space

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 11.3% over past five years.
